start.text: While navigating the subterranean archives beneath the central bank, you uncover a hidden room walled with glowing jade brick. In the center floats a crystalline tablet containing the forgotten records of Thoth, the Egyptian God of Wisdom. The text details a method to safely remove the Aurum Worm without sacrificing your life force, but accessing it requires solving an ancient geometric encryption riddle that strains your consciousness.
start.name: Thoth Archive

choices.text: 🧠 Decipher the scroll's ancient codes to permanently increase your defensive shielding metrics
💥 Smash the tablet violently to absorb its raw cosmic energy, ignoring the historical warnings

decipher_scroll.text: You focus your mind, letting the gold magic rewrite the code layout before your eyes. The tablet dissolves into a warm amber dust that coats your skin, reinforcing your survival tracking bar significantly. You have unlocked a lost defensive protocol.
decipher_scroll.name: System

choices.text: Return to the main banking sector corridors

brutal_smash_scroll.text: You strike the crystalline scroll with a solid gold fist. The archive explodes in a burst of jagged emerald shrapnel. The raw kinetic feedback pieces your armor, but the violent rush of power makes your gold scar burn with malicious authority.
brutal_smash_scroll.name: Musa

choices.text: Stride out of the ruined archive chamber

end_of_sidequest.text: Side-quest logic parameters synchronized with the master timeline data structures. Returning path control to Chapter 16 assets...
end_of_sidequest.name: System

defeat.text: Your survival vitality hits 0%. The golden tracking runes on your skin shatter as your life force fades into the dark rain.
defeat.name: System
